t: A stronger LoRa radio board with solar input for off-grid mesh texting.
steps: Buy the board from the Heltec store or a reseller such as Rokland. In the US, pick the 902 to 928 MHz high-power version.
Check the label to see whether you have the standard V4 or the V4-R8.
Attach the LoRa antenna before you power it up. Never run the radio without it.
Plug it into a computer with a USB-C cable. No extra driver is needed.
Flash the matching Meshtastic build for your version, such as firmware-heltec-v4 for the standard board.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE with the ESP32 board package and set the front-end options for your board revision.
meta: Open Board. From $25.95. A few stores.
